# Change order CO-01: Larkspur Ceramics

## What changes
The order confirmation view shows the stock on hand beside each order line, read from your stock sheet.

## Why
At the milestone 1 demo your operations manager asked to see stock on hand while confirming orders. Your stock sheet is not one of the systems in the agreed scope, so this is new work.

## Price
USD 2,600.00, invoiced when the amendment is signed, due within 14 days of the invoice.

## Schedule
The milestone 2 demo moves one week later, if this is signed by 7 December 2026.

## Acceptance checks it adds
### AC-CO-01.1
- when: an order's lines are on the confirmation view
- then: each line shows the stock on hand for its product code from the stock sheet, as of the last evening update
- how we check: open 5 confirmed orders; each line's stock matches the stock sheet
- test data: 5 orders from the AC-1.1 set and the stock sheet of the same day
- cases: 5
- kind: normal

### AC-CO-01.2
- when: a line's product code is not in the stock sheet
- then: the line shows "stock not known" instead of a number
- how we check: confirm 1 order with a code missing from the stock sheet
- test data: 1 order made for the test
- cases: 1
- kind: error

## Approval
This change order is approved only by a signed amendment to our contract. A reply to this email is not approval, and no work starts before the amendment is signed.
